environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with row-level security. The database has RLS policies on the documents table enforced via session variable: `ALTER TABLE documents ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE documents FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'));`. The connection pool wrapper executes `SET app.current_tenant = $1` at the start of each transaction using the validated tenant ID from the mTLS client certificate CN (not the X-Tenant-ID header). The database role 'app_restricted' has SELECT and UPDATE(metadata) grants only - no raw INSERT/DELETE, and the UPDATE grant is column-restricted to metadata only. Additionally, a pg_audit extension logs all DDL and failed access attempts to CloudWatch.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15, role app_restricted with column-level grants
config.rls_policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents FOR ALL USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant'))
config.session_var_source: mTLS client certificate CN, set via SET app.current_tenant per-transaction
config.column_grants: GRANT SELECT ON documents TO app_restricted; GRANT UPDATE(metadata) ON documents TO app_restricted;
config.audit: pg_audit logging DDL and failed access to CloudWatch
